Health Information Exchange (HIE) has been associated with reduced repeat imaging in Emergency Departments (EDs). This study is among the first to find empirical support for this anticipated benefit of HIE. 

While HIE aims to improve care coordination and reduce unnecessary tests, it can also lead to increased use of services like X-rays or CT scans if patients are referred for them as a result of their interaction with the healthcare system. Therefore, more effective implementation of HIE could help reduce redundant imaging by streamlining the process and minimizing unnecessary referrals.

The key takeaway is that while HIE has shown promise in reducing repeat imaging, it's crucial to continue working on improving its usability and effectiveness to maximize this benefit.
